option_relations.rationale: Post-Stroke Seizure Disorder (Epilepsy) is a broader category that includes various subtypes, such as early and late post-stroke seizure disorders, which are represented by the matched leaf IDs.
Reversible cerebral vasoconstriction syndrome (RCVS) is a specific condition that matches the leaf ID B2.1.
Synthetic Cannabinoid–Induced Toxic Encephalopathy is a specific condition that matches the leaf ID B1.1.
Posterior reversible encephalopathy syndrome (PRES) is a specific condition that matches the leaf ID B2.2.
